text:
zoe: Quick idea — kitchen scavenger bingo today? Winner gets a bagel. Rules: five items on a 3x3 bingo sheet: lonely spoon, mysterious sticky note, lunch Tupperware labeled 'definitely not mine', plant with a new leaf, someone wearing slippers. Who's in? :bingo:
marcos: In. I already have a lonely spoon. :spoon:
anya: I'll bring bagels if I win. :baguette_bread:
sam: I have slippers AND a Tupperware labeled 'definitely not mine' (it's mine). :sweat_smile:
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen trash pickup at 3pm. :garbage_truck:
zoe: @sam liar. This counts as a win if you confess. :eyes:
marcos: Someone stuck a post-it on the plant that says 'do not water' — that's new leaf AND sticky note? :thinking:
anya: 3/5 for me, but I refuse to confess to any Tupperware crimes. :raised_hand:
sam: confession: it was labeled 'definitely not mine' to be ironic. I'm losing dignity for bagels.
zoe: OK bagel tax applied. Winner determination: whoever says 'mic drop' first wins. :mic_drop:
marcos: mic drop. I'll take the bagel and the honor. :trophy:
sam: Can I claim 'most dramatic confession' as a consolation prize? :hand_over_mouth:
